# How many orders a day does your pizzeria need?

> Free pro forma for pizzerias and pizza takeout shops: profit per order, break-even orders a day with the loan, the ticket for your target margin, delivery-app and own-driver cost, and a 60-month ramp-up with the cash reserve you need. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
